items.title: Stage-H STRICT goal isolation: does silencing the E3 goal term change LEARNED avoidance?
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (experiment_purpose=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] DELIBERATELY -- a null must not silently re-weight SD-054/MECH-295/307; route interpretation through governance). Measures the DV the 2026-07-27 scaffold goal-freeze triage explicitly left unmeasured: the triage showed the E3 goal term fires on 100% of Stage-H ticks with 0.65x the harm term's candidate spread and a 38% argmin-flip rate, but that is a SELECTION counterfactual, not a DV. 2 arms x 20 seeds, paired WITHIN seed, differing ONLY in ScaffoldedSD054OnboardingConfig.scaffold_strict_goal_isolation (landed ree-v3 bd66d67f77, default False). Both arms build config from experiments/_lib/baselines/stageh_strict_goal_isolation.py so the single-variable claim holds by construction. CONFIG ANCHOR: V3-EXQ-603q ARM_BASE_IA_ONLY, truncated after Stage-H (P1/P2 dropped -- they run after the frozen stages and cannot inform a Stage-H DV). stage0_enabled + hazard_stage_enabled + feed_harm_stream + train_harm_pathway all ON: without z_goal formation the goal term is inert and the comparison vacuous (the triage's five inert exceptions), and without harm-pathway training the harm cost is a random constant (603i) so survival is unreachable at any budget. SEEDS=20 NOT the family-standard 3, and this is the load-bearing design decision: decomposing 603q's Stage-H episode lengths gives 93% of variance BETWEEN seeds (29.3 vs 8.1 within), so episodes/seed is not a precision lever and seeds are; and 603q's own within-seed arm delta had SD 51.4 against a mean of 23.3, so at n=3 SE_delta ~30 on a ~38-step baseline -- unfalsifiable either way. At n=20, 2*SE ~23.0 steps, under the pre-registered 25-step ceiling, and ~= the measured effect of the FULL escape-affordance bridge, so a null rules out a goal-term effect as large as an entire validated mechanism. Holds while SD_delta<=55.9 (9% margin over 603q). PRE-REGISTERED BOTH DIRECTIONS: outcome PASS = an ANSWER was reached, of either kind -- effect detected (|mean_delta| >= max(2*SE, 5.0 steps)) OR an adequately-powered null (2*SE <= 25.0). The null is recorded as PASS deliberately so it reads as the informative outcome that DISCHARGES the isolation worry, not as a failed run. FAIL only when no answer was reachable: substrate_not_ready_requeue (a readiness precondition unmet) or underpowered_null_more_seeds_required -- NEVER a substrate verdict. Regime-conditioned readiness gate (experiments/_lib/precondition_gate.py, applies_to): goal_term_live_in_stageh applies to ARM_LEGACY only, strict_isolation_applied to ARM_STRICT only -- asserting either on the other arm would make it structurally un-passable (the V3-EXQ-785 lesson). Top-level non_degenerate additionally requires BOTH arms green because the estimand is PAIRED (a green STRICT with a red LEGACY answers nothing); this is a tightening for a paired design, not the 785 defect, since there is no independent per-arm finding to vacate. DV-SYMMETRY: DV = mean Stage-H episode length, invariant under order-preserving changes to the E3 cost (broadcast constant / monotone rescaling). The manipulation is NOT invariant: goal_proximity is PER-CANDIDATE, and the triage measured spread 0.1022 and a 38% argmin flip where a broadcast constant would give exactly 0 and 0. Neither arm is structurally vacuous. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the paired strict-ON-vs-OFF Stage-H survival delta; NO landed manifest carries a strict-ON arm (the knob landed 2026-07-27 default-False and all 78 scaffold importers ran the legacy path -- verified by grep across experiments/ and evidence/experiments/), so it is unrecoverable by reanalysis and must be run. MINT-AS-YOU-GO: cells emitted reuse-eligible with include_driver_script_in_hash=False so a successor's different driver can reuse them. REPRODUCIBILITY: comparison is within-seed AND within-process -- the scaffold curriculum is not reproducible across processes; confirmed again in this session's two smokes (seed 42 ARM_LEGACY Stage-H mean 11.8 then 13.4). NOTE a concurrent session has an UNCOMMITTED scaffold edit adding scaffold_env_layout_seed (unseeded CausalGridWorld construction is the residual entropy source); once landed it would let both arms share an env layout per seed and cut the arm x seed interaction that drives this experiment's seed count -- a worthwhile successor, not depended on here. Smoke PASS (self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue on dry budgets, as designed; manipulation verified biting: LEGACY goal_weight=1.000/e1_gc=True/goal_live=True vs STRICT 0.000/False/False).

items.title: MECH-476 INTERVAL falsifier: retained_fraction vs offline consolidation-window steps (SD-083)
items.note: MECH-476 A->B->A retrograde-interference falsifier, INTERVAL axis. Unblocked by SD-083 offline policy-consolidation window (ree-v3 42ab95f688). Sweeps offline_window_steps {0,150,400,900} at fixed BC dose 300; N=0 is the embedded unconstrained control (c=0, no anchor). DV retained_fraction trajectory; SUPPORTED if monotone-increasing in N with spread>=0.15. Smoke PASS on cloud worker (dry-run plumbing green: capture + ewc_coef grow with N). GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (retained_fraction under an offline window) is recorded in NO prior manifest -- SD-083 just landed, no run has exercised it -> run. offline_ewc_max_coef=100 pre-registered; if first result shows no protection at any N, autopsy disambiguates no-process vs coef-too-weak (a lettered re-calibration, not a verdict).

items.title: MECH-476 NOVELTY falsifier: Moncada behavioural-tagging of a weak install (SD-083)
items.note: MECH-476 falsifier, NOVELTY / behavioural-tagging axis (Moncada & Viola 2007). Unblocked by SD-083. Weak-but-took install (150 BC episodes) x {paired,unpaired} novelty at fixed interval N=300; SUPPORTED if retained_fraction[paired]-[unpaired]>=0.15. Smoke PASS on cloud worker (paired novelty_factor=1.0 measured_novelty=2.63; unpaired pinned 0.05; delta positive in dry-run). GOV-REUSE-1: novelty-gated retention recorded in no prior manifest -> run. CALIBRATION: weak dose chosen so unpaired erodes; if unpaired also fully retains (dose too strong) re-queue lettered at a lower dose, NOT a WEAKENED verdict; install_took gate catches the too-weak case.

items.title: Q-081 prospective cross-stream recording: INTACT vs iei_permute / circular_shift / suppress (RV z_world x operating_mode)
items.note: Q-081 PROSPECTIVE CROSS-STREAM RECORDING RUN (the run named NOT STARTED in q081_surrogate_null_design.md sec.8 and q081_landmark_removal_arm_design.md sec.7). Uses all three landed preconditions together: per-step multi-stream recorder (stream_recorder.py, landed 2026-07 a0289b6/d673790), constrained-realisation surrogate null (q081_surrogate.py), structure-destroying landmark-removal arm (q081_landmark_removal.py). FOUR ARMS per seed from a shared P0 substrate: INTACT (mode=off, banks donor trains) -> IEI_PERMUTE (PRE-REGISTERED PRIMARY, yoked seed/episode-matched joint permutation) -> CIRCULAR_SHIFT (conservative secondary: dissociates loss-of-alignment from loss-of-landmark-train-structure) -> SUPPRESS (LESION reference ONLY, is_lesion=True, NEVER the discriminator). PRIMARY STATISTIC: RV coefficient (Robert & Escoufier 1976) between FULL z_world (E1-rate) and FULL operating_mode (E3-rate) vectors on the coarser tick grid; A-vs-B discriminator is mean RV(INTACT)-RV(IEI_PERMUTE) vs an effect-size floor (K=1.5 * SD of the DELTA, abs floor 0.03). THE 838 FIX over 824a: 824 FAIL (inert arm) and 824a substrate_not_ready_requeue (RV bit-identical across all 5 seeds) were both diagnosed by the 2026-07-28 failure autopsy (failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json, target V3-EXQ-824a, category measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory): use_anchor_sets grants reach to z_world (MECH-269 write_anchor) but NOT to operating_mode (gated on use_per_region_vs via apply_invalidation_broadcasts_to_regions -> vs_rollout_gate -> E3; agent.py:4686-4692), so RV(z_world,operating_mode) could not move. 838 enables BOTH use_anchor_sets=True AND use_per_region_vs=True -- the autopsy's own recommended 'add use_per_region_vs=True and re-verify empirically first' fix (ahead of the heavier Q081-REACH-CHECK-PAIR-SPECIFIC library assertion, which remains follow-on). The arm_statistics_not_degenerately_bit_identical precondition is retained as the guard: if RV STILL does not move, 838 self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue cleanly and confirms the pair-specific reach check is required. MANDATORY GATES (library-implemented, called not reimplemented): assert_behavioural_reach(strict=True) before any recording; screen_statistic on the RV primary AND the artefactual_rate_statistic per seed; preservation_report per arm (preserved_by_construction required for the two yoked arms); input_statistics_divergence per scrambled arm (a breaching seed is CONFOUNDED and excluded -- not reported as a null); lag_control_report (lag is a role=control Outcome-B detector, never the primary readout). INTERPRETATION RULES (also in the manifest interpretation block): (1) clearing the surrogate null is NECESSARY and NOWHERE NEAR SUFFICIENT for Outcome A -- wired coordination clears it correctly; (2) a statistic that SURVIVES the landmark-removal arm was measuring the CLOCK -- Outcome B evidence, NOT support for the claim; (3) neither control, nor both together, is the ABLATION SERIES, which remains the only full A-vs-B discriminator. DV-SYMMETRY (per arm): DV=RV over the realised joint trajectory; the manipulation is a change to boundary-event TIMING (permute/shift/remove) that materially alters the physical trajectory each stream is sampled from -- NOT a broadcast additive constant (RV centres each block), NOT a monotone rescaling (RV is orthogonal-invariant), NOT a permutation of interchangeable units. A null is therefore MEASURED (Outcome B), not an arithmetic identity. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is RV(z_world,operating_mode) INTACT-minus-IEI_PERMUTE delta under use_per_region_vs=True; no recorded run carries it (824/824a ran use_per_region_vs=False -> bit-identical), so unrecoverable by reanalysis -> run. MINT-AS-YOU-GO: baseline/unchanged cells emitted reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False); yoked and P0-shared arms carry explicit ineligibility reasons. seed_replay_rng(seed) is called before the per-arm deepcopy (hippocampal._rng defaults to the unpicklable `random` MODULE; this installs a picklable per-seed Random instance; quiescent under use_sleep_loop=False). No SLEEP DRIVER (waking streams only; Outcome E deferred). CONCURRENCY: opened with task_claim.py --allow-overlap -- shares only experiment_queue.json with a concurrent IGW Q-085 proposal (different experiment, different script), not duplicated work. Smoke PASS (dry-run: all 4 arms run, preservation+input-stats OK, self-routes substrate_not_ready on the too-short dry budget as designed; validate_experiments --strict clean; no evidence pollution).
